description: A synthetic multi-level exam content outline for tests that need a realistic subject hierarchy. The terminology is real medical vocabulary; the structure, category names, ordering and selection are this project's own and are not taken from any published outline. It replaces a verbatim copy of a third party's content outline (#437).
